components.name: Filter chip
components.description: One segment of the verdict filter; the current one carries an ember inset top line.
components.html: all 12undervalued 3fair 5
components.css: .ds-filter { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 1px 0 0 1px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.55 Switzer, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; margin: -1px 0 0 -1px; color: var(--color-ink-2, oklch(84% 0.011 80)); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, oklch(25% 0.010 78)); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 transparent; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-paper-3, oklch(6.5% 0.007 75)); color: var(--color-ink, oklch(94% 0.010 80)); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(78% 0.15 45)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-current] { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(94% 0.010 80)); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 var(--color-accent, oklch(72% 0.17 45)); } .ds-num { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(68% 0.012 80)); }

components.css: .ds-heads { display: flex; gap: 16px; font: 500 0.875rem/1.55 Switzer, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sort { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 0; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(68% 0.012 80)); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-sort:hover { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(94% 0.010 80)); } .ds-sort:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(78% 0.15 45)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sort-on { color: var(--color-ink, oklch(94% 0.010 80)); border-bottom-color: var(--color-accent, oklch(72% 0.17 45)); } .ds-arrow { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(68% 0.012 80)); margin-left: 4px; }

components.name: Facts strip
components.description: The measurements under the verdict: a lead figure and four facts on hairline dividers.
components.css: .ds-facts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr 1fr; margin: 0; padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--color-paper-2, oklch(12.5% 0.009 75)); font-family: Switzer, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-facts > div { padding: 4px 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-rule, oklch(25% 0.010 78)); } .ds-facts > div:first-child { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; } .ds-facts dt { font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted, oklch(68% 0.012 80)); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 400 1.44rem/1.1 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--color-ink, oklch(94% 0.010 80)); } .ds-facts .ds-lead dd { font-size: 2.074rem; }

components.name: Verdict glyphs
components.description: Check, open circle, hatched gate, dash: the verdict by shape first, pigment second.

narrative.overview:
The viewer is read at a desk, beside a terminal, late. It lists the companies the bot has analysed and, for each one, shows why it got its verdict. It is an instrument, not a drawing: the hand-drawn kraft system of the explanatory pieces stops at its door. What crosses over is the honesty, not the stroke. Every number on the page says where it came from, and the page admits what it does not know.

The system is dark only, by decision, and warm: near-black paper tinted toward the ember accent, three steps of it for depth, no shadows. One grotesk sans carries every label and sentence; a mono carries every figure, date and identifier so that a number is recognisable as a number before it is read. Colour is notation. Green, amber and red belong to verdicts and to nothing else; sky-blue belongs to the intrinsic value; ember belongs to the interface's own state and to nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, warm, flat. Depth from three paper tones and hairline rules, never shadows or blur.
One sans for words, one mono for figures. The mono is a signal, not a style.
Colour is semantic: three verdict pigments, one intrinsic blue, one interface ember.
Charts that do not shrink their text: HTML labels beside scaled SVG, tables where a chart would hide the numbers.
Everything is a real link to a real page; htmx only makes it faster.

rules.name: The Notation Rule
rules.body: A colour means one thing on every screen. Green, amber and red are verdicts; sky is intrinsic value; ember is the interface. If a new element needs colour and none of those meanings fit, it is drawn in ink or muted.

rules.name: The Shape-First Rule
rules.body: No verdict is told by colour alone. The check, the open circle, the hatched gate and the dash carry the verdict in greyscale; the pigment confirms it.

rules.name: The Muted Floor Rule
rules.body: muted is the lightest colour text may use. muted-stroke is for lines. A label that needs to recede goes smaller or lighter in weight, not greyer.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is never used for a word that is not a value, a date, a ticker or an identifier out of the analysis code. Labels and sentences stay in Switzer.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from the rem scale (0.875, 1, 1.2, 1.44, 1.728, 2.074). No clamp(); the layout reflows structurally instead.

rules.name: The Flat Night Rule
rules.body: If an element needs to come forward, it gets a lighter surface or a rule above it, never a shadow. If it needs to recede, it gets the deeper paper.

dos: Do keep every control reachable by keyboard and keep focus on the control that was activated after a swap.
Do set figures, dates and identifiers in Geist Mono with tabular numerals, right-aligned in tables.
Do explain a chart in one sentence under its heading, and name the thresholds the verdict depends on (1.0×, 1.3×).
Do give every verdict a shape and a title as well as a colour.
Do reflow on the detail pane's own width (container queries), not the window's.
Do keep text out of scaled SVG; label with HTML or use a table.
donts: Don't build the fintech dashboard: no navy and gold, no big metric cards, no green lines.
Don't build the SaaS landing page: no gradients, no isometric illustration, no grid of identical cards.
Don't build the Confluence diagram: grey boxes, straight arrows, system type, no hierarchy.
Don't take the editorial-typographic lane: italic serif display, mono labels, rules and monochrome.
Don't use a cream, sand or near-white paper; the viewer is dark only.
Don't use ember on content or on a verdict; it belongs to the interface's state.
Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a coloured stripe.
Don't use gradient text, glass, blur, shadows, bounce or elastic easing.
Don't gate any content on an animation; motion is 120 to 220ms, opacity and a 4px rise, and disappears under reduced motion.
Don't ship session notes, provenance comments or unused tokens in the stylesheet.
